blocks.label: portal

// the region: a thin slab "size" across, the portal's window
C = add_new(C, sdBox(p, size * 0.5), MATERIAL);

warp.code:
// turn the ray about this box's z by "twist" radians per mm
dir = rotZ(twist * ds) * dir;

// pulled towards the middle by "pull", as 1/r^2, held at 5 mm so the middle is no hole
dir = normalize(dir - normalize(p) * pull * ds / max(dot(p, p), 25.0));

// turned at random by about "amount" radians per mm: what is behind it blurs, like heat haze
dir = normalize(dir + (VEC3(rand(), rand(), rand()) - 0.5) * amount * ds);

// out "shift" away in the scene, going the way it went
posWorld = world + shift;
